identity.name: Aquanaut
identity.one_liner: The 40mm steel Aquanaut on its Tropical composite strap — the last accessible door into Patek steel sports.

comps.condition: Tiffany & Co.-stamped Certificate of Origin dated 21 June 2011
Tiffany & Co.-signed dial, near-mint; same Certificate of Origin as the December 2023 Phillips lot

narrative.story: The Aquanaut launched in 1997 as the young, rubber-strapped answer to the Nautilus; the 5167A of 2007 fixed the format at 40mm and became the modern reference point. Embossed grenade-pattern dial, matching Tropical composite strap, caliber 324 S C then 26-330 S C. After the 5711 died, the 5167A absorbed much of the steel-Patek demand; the bracelet version 5167/1A was discontinued, leaving the strap model as the remaining steel Aquanaut time-and-date.
narrative.collector_notes: Straps age and are a real recurring cost — original Patek replacements only, and the fitted ends date the watch. Note the caliber generation on the certificate, and be aware that retailer-signed dials (the Phillips Tiffany result) trade in a separate universe from standard examples.
